correctness.rationale: Every section vertex is a transverse crossing of a zonotope edge almost everywhere; each generator-zone edge contributes projected length. The restricted arrangement chambers are in bijection with these edges. Nonparallel generator directions make the ridge derivative jump isolate each multiplicity, proving necessity. The region formula and d=3 special case follow from central line arrangements. Three independent integer hull edge enumerations with 21 exact offset-integration comparisons corroborate the proof.

value.rationale: An exact complete criterion deciding orientation-independent affine-section complexity of any zonotope is a natural inverse-structural classification. It distinguishes generic, nongeneric balanced and unbalanced cases and identifies precisely when Swan’s parallelotope phenomenon persists under generator dependencies. The complete all-dimensional criterion—not just a recomputed edge count—motivates the work.
